title: Curate open/cell-line ES RNA-seq positives (accessions + evidence + license)
context: M3 real-data curation for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Curates open/cell-line ES RNA-seq positives as accessions + fetch recipes only - never re-hosting reads unless a license clearly permits - per the binding open-data guardrail. Each entry carries citation, evidence-strength, license, and a re-identifiability check; a compliance reviewer confirms no controlled-access or identifiable data is included.
objective: Curate >=10 open/cell-line ES RNA-seq positives as accessions + fetch recipe, each with citation, evidence-strength, license, and a passed re-identifiability check, compliance-confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: >=10 cell-line/open positives recorded as accessions + fetch recipe (no re-hosting unless license clearly permits); each with citation + evidence-strength + license + re-identifiability check = pass.
Compliance reviewer confirms no controlled-access/identifiable data.
output: data/real/positives-accessions.tsv — accession + fetch-recipe + license records for open/cell-line ES positives (no re-hosted reads).
